root_cause.text: The error handling path in the `sev_tsm_init_locked()` function of the crypto/ccp subsystem incorrectly deallocates the memory of the `t` structure via `kfree()` before dereferencing its members in a `pr_err()` logging statement.
root_cause.evidence: The patch diff shows that under the `error_exit:` label in `drivers/crypto/ccp/sev-dev-tsm.c`, `kfree(t)` is moved from before the `pr_err()` call (which accesses `t->tio_en` and `t->tio_init_done`) to after it.
